title: Florida Rapper Ghostluvme Drops Memorable New Project
htmlContent:
Ghostluvme is an emerging rapper hailing from Broward County, Florida. In just two years since making his music debut, he has laid down a marker and shown he is an artist to watch out for. Working with some of the biggest producers in the industry such as Zaytoven (Travis Scott, Future, Lil Wayne) and Scott Storch (Megan Thee Stallion, Jack Harlow, Trippie Redd), he has accumulated over 15 million streams on Spotify alone and will only increase this number further after the release of his new project, Mixtape.

Featuring six tracks, including standout “Bowser", the project is a great listen and will draw listeners in with its captivating production (courtesy of Paqboygrazi) and Ghostluvme’s infectious hooks, impressive lyricism and effortless ability to switch his flow during each track. With another great project under his belt and more music expected in the coming months, his incredible rise will surely continue and see him break new ground.

Speaking on the new project, Ghostluvme says: “I made this tape in one day. ‘Bowser’ is a special track, and I released it as therapy for myself. All the beats are produced by my brother for life, Paqboygrazi, and I’ve got more soon to come. I hope everyone enjoys it.”

Buy/stream Mixtape here.
